children.title: Interview Landscape and Design Framework Foundations
children.summary: Maps the modern MLE loop, sets up the step-by-step ML system design framework with the first worked cases and the training-data chapter, and starts daily coding and fundamentals recall so later months can build on them.

children.title: Search, Moderation and Recommendation Designs with Deployment
children.summary: Works through the video search, harmful content and recommendation case designs alongside model deployment and prediction serving, turning the framework into regular timed design exercises and first mock interviews while coding practice deepens.

children.title: Ranking, Feeds and Monitoring Under Mock Pressure
children.summary: Finishes with the hardest ranking and graph designs—ad click prediction, similar listings, news feed and people-you-may-know—plus distribution shift and monitoring, and spends most time on full design exercises and mock interviews to rehearse the real loop.
